points.text: A promise you keep, like fixed prices

content.title: Answers before you ask
content.body: The things people want to know before they get in touch. Anything else, just ask.

questions.question: How quickly can you come out?
questions.answer: A short, straight answer: two or three sentences, with the detail people actually need before they get in touch.

questions.question: Do you charge for a quote?
questions.answer: No. Quotes are free and in writing, usually within a day.

questions.question: Which areas do you cover?
questions.answer: Leeds and anywhere within about 20 miles.

questions.question: Are you insured and accredited?
questions.answer: Yes: fully insured, and Gas Safe registered.

questions.question: How do I pay?
questions.answer: By bank transfer or card when the job's done. **No deposits** for jobs under £500.
